_doc: The application evaluator runs each case as a baseline/no-skill arm and a with-skill arm, then grades behavior against expected_flags, expected_fix_hints, absent_signals, and the per-case criteria checklist.
subject: SWOT and TOWS strategy option generation for organizations, products, programs, and projects: separate internal…

cases.scenario: A user asks: "Build a SWOT and TOWS matrix for this product strategy."
cases.context: The agent has access to the swot-tows skill and must decide whether to use it, apply its procedure, and stay inside its boundaries.
cases.question: What should the agent do, and why is swot-tows the right skill to apply?
expected_flags: Recognizes swot-tows as applicable to this request
Uses the skill-specific purpose or mental model instead of generic advice
Names the relevant boundary against positioning, porters-five-forces, seven-powers
Turns the request into concrete steps, checks, or decisions from the skill
expected_fix_hints: Apply the swot-tows workflow to the concrete scenario
State the next action and the evidence or verification needed
Call out any adjacent skill that should own a different part of the request
absent_signals: Does not answer with generic advice that could ignore swot-tows
Does not route to positioning, porters-five-forces, seven-powers when the swot-tows scope is the owner
Does not invent certification, freshness, or runtime success claims without evidence

cases.scenario: A user asks: "Analyze supplier power, buyer power, entrants, substitutes, and rivalry."
cases.context: This is a boundary test. The skill should avoid false-positive activation and route to the better owner when appropriate.
cases.question: Should swot-tows be applied here? If not, what should happen instead?
expected_flags: Recognizes the request is outside swot-tows's ownership
Routes the work to positioning or asks for the missing owner instead of forcing this skill
Preserves any real issue in the request without applying swot-tows terminology incorrectly
expected_fix_hints: Decline to apply swot-tows as the primary skill
Name the better owner or the boundary reason
Offer only a narrow handoff if swot-tows has a secondary support role

Does not suppress the correct adjacent owner
